newsitem.title: USA: Intercargo reviewing contract bonds fit.
newsitem.headline: Intercargo reviewing contract bonds fit.

text.p: Intercargo Corp said Thursday it was reviewing the strategic fit of its contract bonds with the company's other products and the options that may be available to limit its exposure to volatility in this line.

While U.S. customs bonds continue strong, Intercargo said the overall surety line during the fourth quarter of 1996 was hurt by the contract bond line deterioration, which forced an overall increase to surety reserves in the quarter.
Earlier Thursday, Intercargo posted fourth-quarter earnings of $0.37 per share compared to a year-ago loss of $0.47.

It said in its primary lines, marine loss experience continued to improve. Property and causalty also continued to improve, with the fourth-quarter loss ratio 64.9 percent compared to 77.3 percent for the full year.
"Intercargo will continue to focus its efforts on our primary markets and to deliver the products needed by those customers," said chief executive officer James Zuhlke in a statement.
